rules.title: Check mounted after await
rules.body: After an await inside a State method, check if (!mounted) return; before using BuildContext or calling setState.

rules.title: Dispose controllers and subscriptions
rules.body: TextEditingControllers, AnimationControllers, StreamSubscriptions and other disposable objects created by a State are disposed in dispose().

rules.title: Futures are awaited or unawaited explicitly
rules.body: Every Future is awaited, returned, or wrapped in unawaited() with a comment; none is silently dropped.

rules.title: No ! on nullable values from outside
rules.body: Do not use the ! operator on values from JSON, platform channels, route arguments or other outside sources; check them.

rules.title: User-facing text is localised
rules.body: Strings shown to users come from the app's localisation (AppLocalizations), never string literals in widgets.
